data.title: Jacob Ay gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
As a trade member who regularly manages large orders for clients, this has been the most disorganized and stressful retail experience I have ever had.

I placed two large orders with Lulu and Georgia and paid a significant premium for white glove delivery. At no point during the purchasing process was it made clear that items would be delivered before I had the opportunity to schedule them. Isn't scheduling the entire point of paying for white glove service?

Two items have already been delivered before my client even has access to the home. Today, I received a notification from Lulu and Georgia's white glove delivery partner stating that two large rugs are scheduled to arrive tomorrow—yet nobody ever contacted me to arrange a delivery date. There was no scheduling process whatsoever.

What makes this even more frustrating is the complete lack of communication. This morning I emailed my trade representative, the trade team, and customer service seeking clarification and assistance. I received no response. Meanwhile, the white glove delivery company does not answer its phone, leaving me with no way to manage deliveries that are supposedly being coordinated on my behalf.

To add to the confusion, I have also received emails claiming the delivery address is "remote access," which is simply not true. When I asked for an explanation, I again received no response.

Since placing these orders, new issues have surfaced almost daily. I now find myself anxiously waiting for the next problem to arise, wondering what will go wrong next. This level of disorganization is unacceptable, especially for a company serving design professionals whose reputations depend on reliable execution.

Most concerning of all, this experience is making me look unprofessional in front of my clients. Paying thousands of dollars for products and premium delivery services should not result in this level of chaos, poor communication, and lack of accountability.

I cannot recommend Lulu and Georgia to other designers or trade professionals based on this experience.
